t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Me guer go Allah yam, Kad yi râm Kad m'guério m'doi o. M'guer go rotam, tam ri wa togoum goto ngang Yai o, ndô yam o i yan kingué Yai. Allah krang ki toi goto, Yi ngué korjiko kem yah ki madjal guetio, Yi kba tel roi yi Allah.
